# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 3

Playback diagnostics show the provider failure code, retry status, attempt number, and elapsed time. Sentry groups failures by an approved set of codes. Provider messages, request details, and credentials are excluded from this reporting.

Android keeps native plugin resources available across configuration changes and plugin reloads.

Install the signed Android app APK over a matching MetroFuse installation, or extract the Windows x64 ZIP into a new folder and run the launcher. To test FLAC separately, import the standalone FLAC plugin APK through MetroFuse's plugin manager. Turn on crash reporting in MetroFuse if you want failed playback attempts to reach Sentry.
